intro: Simple Tablet is an introductory rite of passage for fledgling warriors entering the Valley of Trials. Delivered into your hands after proving your mettle against local beasts, it directs you toward Frang, the local veteran tasked with honing raw brawn into martial discipline.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the warrior trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Another traveler to bolster the ranks. Good enough for me.
You'll probably have a hard time hefting a good weapon like an axe, but a spear's just as good as anything else.
Welcome to the Valley of Trials.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You'll find this place fitting as you continue to train in the adventurer ways. If you have any questions, feel free to ask anyone around, and when you feel you're ready, come back to me for training. I've mastered as much as any adventurer here in the Valley and can pass that knowledge on to you... For a price.
